description: See at a glance which agents are working, which need an answer and which are done, with spawned chats nested under their parent. Group chats by project, last update, status or environment, or draw one flat list, and narrow every grouping to one project from the switcher. With the Projects plugin, a worker opens as a tab of its project lead, so the lead's side panel stays in view. After install the sidebar switches to the Cursor navigation layout, and Compact is one setting away. Give each project a glyph in one of ten colours or an uploaded PNG, filter by status, age, environment or pull request, and spot chats on cloud machines by their cloud mark. Needs BB 0.49 or newer; no account or external service.
